root_cause: The list items in the Awesomplete dropdown have tabindex='0', making them focusable and causing the Tab key to move focus into the list instead of skipping to the next form field.
repair_strategy: Change the tabindex of list items from '0' to '-1' to remove them from the tab order while preserving ARIA roles and keyboard navigation via arrow keys.
expected_accessibility_effect: When suggestions are visible, a single Tab press will move focus from the city combobox to the next form field (dietary requirements), restoring expected keyboard navigation order.
functional_risks: Talkback screen reader users who previously relied on tabbing into list items may experience a change in interaction; however, arrow key navigation and screen reader announcements via aria-activedescendant remain functional.
verification_requirements: After typing 'Ber' in the city field and pressing Tab, focus must shift to the dietary input field.
Arrow Up/Down keys must still navigate within the suggestion list.
Enter key must still highlight and select a suggestion.
List items must not be focusable via the Tab key.
